source: create a game for me that is EXACTLY like Apocalypse Rising 2 but instead change the spawning weapons with m1911 and a hunting knife make sure it's 3d with a big map and multiple areas to loot some areas with have civilian rarity loot some will have Soviet some with have military and there will be super rare special loot

image_prompt.text: Open buildable ground where players can raise shelters and fortifications
a big map split into multiple distinct areas to travel between and loot
a Soviet-themed area holding mid-tier loot, visually distinct from the civilian areas
military areas stocked with the higher-tier loot

layout_placement.text: Lootable gear placed through the world - civilian-grade in ordinary areas, better in the Soviet and military ones
super rare special loot in a small number of places
spawn points where every player starts with an M1911 and a hunting knife and nothing else

notes: The Biome World shape scales regions by threat level; this prompt scales them by loot rarity instead. The shape is being used for a purpose it does not describe.
Preset caveat: Resource Survival carries buildable player ground, which the prompt never mentions. Kept per batch policy; it traces to the preset.
The prompt's central instruction is 'EXACTLY like Apocalypse Rising 2'. No field in this handoff can carry a reference title, so the whole instruction is dropped except where it informs theme.

open_questions.ask: What ends a session - is this a persistent survival world with permadeath, or a round with a win condition?
Is the threat other players, zombies or AI, or the environment? Nothing in the prompt says what you are surviving.

coverage_missing.ask: Is there a win condition, or is this a persistent world you survive in until you die?
What is the threat - zombies, other players, or both? The prompt names loot and weapons but never an enemy.
How big is 'big'? Apocalypse-style maps run several thousand studs across, which is a different build from a district.
How many loot areas of each tier, and how many super-rare spots?

answers.ask: What ends a session - is this a persistent survival world with permadeath, or a round with a win condition?
answers.answer: Make it a persistent survival world with permadeath, like Apocalypse Rising 2; there is no round win condition.

answers.ask: Is the threat other players, zombies or AI, or the environment? Nothing in the prompt says what you are surviving.
answers.answer: The main threat is other players and zombies/AI in the open-world survival map.
